"""Selected P6 final qualification; run only after parent confirms final build.

Reuses unchanged original A/A/C input and retained probe/observer recipe. This
does not author, repair or commit drawings, rebuild targets, or qualify native
meaning of the redundant Attribute alignment.
"""
import argparse
import ast
import hashlib
import json
import logging
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time
import traceback

root=Path.cwd()
prepared=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.pycache_prefix=str(prepared/"absent-bytecode-cache")
assert not Path(sys.pycache_prefix).exists()
sys.dont_write_bytecode=True
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/"tools"))
import ezdxf
from ezdxf.lldxf.tagger import ascii_tags_loader,binary_tags_loader
from ezdxf.lldxf.tags import group_tags
from bounded_process import run_bounded

# Reuse exact retained literal observer/runner without executing its authoring.
author=prepared.parent/"original-owner-authored/experiment.py"
module=ast.parse(author.read_text())
functions=ast.Module(body=[node for node in module.body if isinstance(node,ast.FunctionDef)
    and node.name in ("sha","physical","run")],type_ignores=[])
exec(compile(functions,str(author),"exec"),globals())

SOURCE_SHA="c0800a1c9b7532e6047492b3b36d174cb15c41d09f1bf49aca5a6b2451c24b21"
BASELINE_SHA="32cabcde21eb5f5dc20f48a7f0221f3f92af2a23d550c4ce19ad6079287466a0"
WANTED={"ATTDEF": [[11,12,13],[11,12,13],[21,22,23]],
        "ATTRIB": [[31,32,33],[31,32,33],[41,42,43]]}


def manifest_entries(path):
    rows={}
    for line in path.read_text().splitlines():
        digest,name=line.split(None,1)
        assert len(digest)==64 and name not in rows
        target=root/name
        assert target.is_file() and sha(target)==digest, "source manifest mismatch: "+name
        rows[name]=digest
    assert rows
    return rows


def selected_owner_chain(path,binary):
    if binary:
        records=list(group_tags(binary_tags_loader(path.read_bytes(),errors="strict")))
    else:
        with path.open(encoding="utf-8",errors="strict") as stream:
            records=list(group_tags(ascii_tags_loader(stream)))
    scoped=[]
    scope=None
    for record in records:
        if record[0].value=="SECTION":scope=record.get_first_value(2)
        elif record[0].value=="ENDSEC":scope=None
        else:scoped.append((scope,record))
    def get(kind,code,value,scope):
        rows=[r for s,r in scoped if s==scope and r[0].value==kind and r.get_first_value(code,None)==value]
        assert len(rows)==1, (kind,code,value,scope,len(rows))
        return rows[0]
    def handle(record,code=5):return int(str(record.get_first_value(code)).strip(),16)
    definition=get("ATTDEF",2,"PEER","BLOCKS")
    child=get("ATTRIB",2,"PEER","ENTITIES")
    parent=get("INSERT",2,"PeerEmbedded","ENTITIES")
    provider=get("BLOCK_RECORD",2,"PeerEmbedded","TABLES")
    control=get("TABLE",2,"BLOCK_RECORD","TABLES")
    block=get("BLOCK",2,"PeerEmbedded","BLOCKS")
    modelspace=[r for s,r in scoped if s=="TABLES" and r[0].value=="BLOCK_RECORD"
                and str(r.get_first_value(2,"")).upper()=="*MODEL_SPACE"]
    assert len(modelspace)==1
    entities=[r for s,r in scoped if s=="ENTITIES"]
    at=next(i for i,r in enumerate(entities) if r is parent)
    assert entities[at+1] is child and entities[at+2][0].value=="SEQEND"
    footer=entities[at+2]
    assert int(str(parent.get_first_value(66)).strip())==1
    assert handle(definition,330)==handle(provider)==handle(block,330)
    assert handle(provider,330)==handle(control)
    assert handle(parent,330)==handle(modelspace[0])
    assert handle(child,330)==handle(parent)==handle(footer,330)
    selected={"blockRecord":provider,"blockBegin":block,"definition":definition,
              "parent":parent,"child":child,"footer":footer}
    identities=[handle(record) for record in selected.values()]
    assert all(identities) and len(set(identities))==len(identities)
    return dict(identities={name:dict(kind=r[0].value,handle=r.get_first_value(5),
        owner=r.get_first_value(330,None)) for name,r in selected.items()},
        modelSpaceBlockRecord=modelspace[0].get_first_value(5),
        blockRecordControl=control.get_first_value(5),actualConsecutiveCompound=True,
        declaredBlockName="PeerEmbedded",exactSelectedOwnerChain=True,
        allSelectedLiteralRecords={name:[[t.code,t.value] for t in r] for name,r in selected.items()})


def ordinary_peer(path,physical_row,owners):
    messages=[]
    class Log(logging.Handler):
        def emit(self,record):messages.append(dict(level=record.levelname,message=record.getMessage()))
    logger=logging.getLogger("ezdxf");handler=Log();logger.addHandler(handler)
    try:doc=ezdxf.readfile(path)
    finally:logger.removeHandler(handler)
    rows=[]
    for row in physical_row["selected"]:
        entity=doc.entitydb[row["handle"]]
        mtext=entity.virtual_mtext_entity()
        assert list(entity.dxf.align_point)==WANTED[row["kind"]][0]
        assert list(mtext.dxf.insert)==WANTED[row["kind"]][2]
        assert entity.dxf.lock_position==1
        rows.append(dict(kind=row["kind"],handle=row["handle"],
            fallbackAlignment=list(entity.dxf.align_point),embeddedInsertion=list(mtext.dxf.insert),
            lock=entity.dxf.lock_position))
    ids=owners["identities"]
    parent=doc.entitydb[ids["parent"]["handle"]]
    child=doc.entitydb[ids["child"]["handle"]]
    footer=doc.entitydb[ids["footer"]["handle"]]
    assert parent.attribs==[child] and parent.seqend is footer
    return dict(selected=rows,actualLinkedChild=child.dxf.handle,actualLinkedFooter=footer.dxf.handle,
        ordinaryFooterOwner=footer.dxf.owner,physicalFooterOwner=ids["footer"]["owner"],
        linkageAdvisoryOnly=True,explicitAudit=False,explicitRecover=False,
        intrinsicRecovery="Attrib/AttDef loader uses fast_load_dxfattribs(recover=True)",
        implicitOwnerNormalization="LinkedEntities.link_seqend resets footer owner to parent owner; original owner chain is proved solely from literal tags before setup",
        messages=messages)


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--manifest",type=Path,required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir",type=Path,required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--development",action="store_true",
        help="explicit selected-production-input development binding; never final qualification")
    args=parser.parse_args()
    output=args.output_dir.resolve()
    assert not output.exists() or not any(output.iterdir()), "output directory must be empty"
    output.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    assert ezdxf.__version__=="1.4.5"
    manifest=args.manifest.resolve(strict=True)
    source=author.parent/"original-AC1032.dxf"
    baseline=author.parent/"selected-writer-only/analysis.json"
    assert sha(source)==SOURCE_SHA and sha(baseline)==BASELINE_SHA
    original=physical(source)
    for row in original["selected"]:
        assert [r["values"] for r in row["triples"]]==WANTED[row["kind"]]
    original["ownerChainBeforeOrdinarySetup"]=selected_owner_chain(source,False)
    obj=root/"build/tests/CMakeFiles/libdxfrw_test_adapter.dir/__/dwg2dxf/dx_iface.cpp.o"
    library=root/"build/libdxfrw.a"
    cpp=prepared/"source-output-probe.cpp"
    executable=output/"source-output-probe"
    bound_paths=[manifest,obj,library,cpp,Path(__file__),author,source,baseline,Path(sys.executable)]
    entries=manifest_entries(manifest)
    if not args.development:
        assert len(entries)>=500,"final qualification requires the complete source manifest"
    report=dict(schema="P6-selected-embedded-writer-independent-qualification-v1",
        runKind="development-selected-inputs" if args.development else "final-complete-source-manifest",
        supportClaimsPromoted=False,nativeSemanticQualification=False,
        sourceProfileQualification=False,wholeOriginalDocumentExportQualified=False,
        targetBuildsRun=False,trackedEdits=False,drawingFixtureCommits=False,
        scope="Selected production writer/readback preserves independent original typed A/C coordinates and matching physical A/A/C tuples; full source semantic roles remain open",
        baseline=dict(path=str(baseline),sha256=sha(baseline)),original=original,
        sourceManifest=dict(path=str(manifest),sha256=sha(manifest)),
        sourceEntriesBefore=entries,
        bindingsBefore={str(p):sha(p) for p in bound_paths},
        successfulWriterIdentityBehavior="Direct production writer may update source model handle fields; coordinates are checked separately before/after each write. Pre-export original proof is not reused after those handle changes.")
    report["selectedWriterOwnerSetup"]="setSourceBlockRecords(original.blockRecords,true) registers genuine source BLOCK_RECORD identities before write; selected ATTDEF uses the actual emitted PeerEmbedded BLOCK_RECORD owner and production writeInsert owns child/footer handles. This is ordinary writer context setup, not input/model repair."
    try:
        report["compile"]=run(["/usr/bin/clang++","-std=c++17","-Wall","-Wextra","-Werror",
            "-I.","-Isrc","-Ibuild",str(cpp),str(obj),str(library),"-o",str(executable)])
        assert report["compile"]["exitCode"]==0,"scratch probe compilation failed"
        report["executableSha256"]=sha(executable)
        prefix=output/"actual-selected-output"
        report["write"]=run([str(executable),str(source),str(prefix),"write"])
        assert report["write"]["exitCode"]==0,"production selected write failed"
        report["outputsBeforeOrdinaryReadback"]=[]
        for suffix,binary in (("-asc.dxf",False),("-bin.dxf",True)):
            path=Path(str(prefix)+suffix)
            row=physical(path,binary)
            for selected in row["selected"]:
                assert [r["values"] for r in selected["triples"]]==WANTED[selected["kind"]],"emitted selected triple mismatch"
            row["ownerChainBeforeOrdinarySetup"]=selected_owner_chain(path,binary)
            report["outputsBeforeOrdinaryReadback"].append(row)
        report["read"]=run([str(executable),str(source),str(prefix),"read"])
        assert report["read"]["exitCode"]==0,"production selected readback changed typed A/C fields"
        report["ordinaryPeerOriginal"]=ordinary_peer(source,original,original["ownerChainBeforeOrdinarySetup"])
        for row in report["outputsBeforeOrdinaryReadback"]:
            path=Path(row["path"])
            row["ordinaryPeerAdvisory"]=ordinary_peer(path,row,row["ownerChainBeforeOrdinarySetup"])
            assert sha(path)==row["sha256"],"output changed during ordinary readback"
        report["sourceEntriesAfter"]=manifest_entries(manifest)
        report["bindingsAfter"]={str(p):sha(p) for p in bound_paths}
        assert report["sourceEntriesBefore"]==report["sourceEntriesAfter"]
        assert report["bindingsBefore"]==report["bindingsAfter"]
        assert sha(source)==SOURCE_SHA and sha(executable)==report["executableSha256"]
        report.update(passed=True,sourceBytesUnchanged=True,outputBytesUnchangedDuringReadback=True,
            sourceBindingsStable=True,asciiAndBinaryPhysicalTuplesMatched=4,
            asciiAndBinarySelectedOwnerChainsMatched=2,productionTypedReadbackEntityFormsMatched=4,
            ordinaryPeerStoredFieldFormsMatched=6)
    except Exception as exc:
        report.update(passed=False,failureType=type(exc).__name__,failure=str(exc),
            failureTraceback=traceback.format_exc())
    report["loadedEzdxfModules"]={name:dict(path=str(Path(module.__file__).resolve()),sha256=sha(module.__file__))
        for name,module in sorted(sys.modules.items()) if name.startswith("ezdxf")
        and getattr(module,"__file__",None) and Path(module.__file__).is_file()}
    path=output/"qualification.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+"\n")
    print(json.dumps(dict(path=str(path),sha256=sha(path),passed=report["passed"],
        failure=report.get("failure")),indent=2))
    return 0 if report["passed"] else 1


if __name__=="__main__":sys.exit(main())
